description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Earth, Holy)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wol], [Purging Steel Damage Tracker] and [Purging Steel Level] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Earth, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth]/[Attach Holy] after using a Earth/Holy ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wol
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Purging Steel (0~2), removed after using Purging Steel two times

description.name: Purging Steel Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Purging Steel level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wol]

description.name: Purging Steel Level
description.text: Keeps track of Purging Steel level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wol]
